Purpose: I want to use edit distance to calculate the distinctiveness of the datasets I manipulate the parameters for and generate. This specifically calculates the edit distance within the dataset to see how different are the strings in one CSV from the strings in another CSV? Between group variation.

read two csv and call character strings

```{r}
high_length <- read.csv(list_data[1]) # length - 12, bases - 3, high indiv
low_length <- read.csv(list_data[41]) # length - 8, bases - 3, high indiv

calls_hi <- high_length$Call
calls_low <- low_length$Call 

```

Create function to calculate between groups
```{r}

calculate_between_distance <- function(calls1,
                                       calls2,
                                       n_samples = 10000){

  distances <- numeric(n_samples)

  for(i in 1:n_samples){

    s1 <- sample(calls1, 1)

    s2 <- sample(calls2, 1)

    dist <- stringdist(
      s1,
      s2,
      method = "lv"
    )
    
    # normalized distance to account for different lengths
    distances[i] <- dist / max(nchar(s1), nchar(s2))

  }

  mean_dist <- mean(distances)
  cat("Mean:", mean_dist, "\n")
  
  return(mean_dist)

}

```

Test function
```{r}

between_mean <- calculate_between_distance(
  calls_hi,
  calls_low,
  n_samples = 10000
)
# Mean: 0.5257

```

Create information about every file to be able to sort by treatment
```{r}

file_info <- data.frame(file = list_data)

file_info$string_length <- ifelse(
  str_detect(file_info$file, "string_length_12"),
  "High",
  "Low"
)

file_info$num_characters <- ifelse(
  str_detect(file_info$file, "bases_7"),
  "High",
  "Low"
)

file_info$dataset_size <- ifelse(
  str_detect(file_info$file, "high_individuals"),
  "High",
  "Low"
)

file_info$iteration <-
  as.numeric(str_extract(file_info$file,
                         "(?<=iteration_)\\d+"))

head(file_info)

```

Helper function to make comparison tables
```{r}

make_comparison_table <- function(file_info, factor){

  # Columns should stay the same
  matching_columns <- c(
    "string_length",
    "num_characters",
    "dataset_size",
    "iteration"
  )

  # Remove the factor we're changing
  matching_columns <- setdiff(matching_columns, factor)

  # Join the table with itself
  comparison_table <-
    inner_join(
      file_info,
      file_info,
      by = matching_columns,
      suffix = c("1", "2")
    )

  # Keep only rows where the chosen factor is different
  comparison_table <-
    comparison_table %>%
    filter(.data[[paste0(factor, "1")]] !=
           .data[[paste0(factor, "2")]])

  # Remove duplicate comparisons
  comparison_table <-
    comparison_table %>%
    filter(file1 < file2)

  return(comparison_table)

}

```

Run helper function that makes comparison table
```{r}

comparison_length <-
  make_comparison_table(
    file_info,
    "string_length"
  )

comparison_characters <-
  make_comparison_table(
    file_info,
    "num_characters"
  )

comparison_dataset <-
  make_comparison_table(
    file_info,
    "dataset_size"
  )

head(comparison_length)

```

Helper function to run edit distance between for all files based on treatment
```{r}

compare_files <- function(comparison_table){

  results <- data.frame()

  for(i in 1:nrow(comparison_table)){

    cat("Comparing", i, "of", nrow(comparison_table), "\n")

    # choose a file1 and file2 from the comparison table
    file1 <- comparison_table$file1[i]
    file2 <- comparison_table$file2[i]

    # read the chosen file1 and file2
    dat1 <- read.csv(file1)
    dat2 <- read.csv(file2)

    # extract the character string for analysis
    strings1 <- dat1$Call
    strings2 <- dat2$Call

    # calculate edit distance of the two calls from the two different files
    d <- calculate_between_distance(
      strings1,
      strings2,
      n_samples = 10000
    )

    # make a dataframe with the results of the edit distance 
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(
        file1 = file1,
        file2 = file2,
        normalized_distance = d
      )
    )
  }

  results
}

```

run it
```{r}

results_length <-
    compare_files(comparison_length)

results_characters <-
    compare_files(comparison_characters)

results_dataset <-
    compare_files(comparison_dataset)

```

check it
```{r}

nrow(comparison_length)
nrow(comparison_characters)
nrow(comparison_dataset)

```

```{r}

results_length$factor <- "string_length"
results_characters$factor <- "num_characters"
results_dataset$factor <- "dataset_size"

all_results <- rbind(
  results_length,
  results_characters,
  results_dataset
)

write.csv(all_results,
          file.path(edit_path, "all_edit_between_distance_results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
